newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ASM Lithography wins $150 mln order.
newsitem.headline: ASM Lithography wins $150 mln order.

text.p: Semiconductor equipment maker ASM Lithography said on Thursday it had won an order worth over $150 million from Micron Technology.
"We are extremely pleased to have an industry leader such as Micron make this significant investment in our steppers," said Willem Maris, president and chief executive officer of ASM Lithography.
Installation of the systems at Micron's operations in Boise, Idaho, is scheduled to begin in the fourth quarter.
Micron Technology is one of the world's largest makers of computer memory chips.
